visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older man wearing a grey sweatshirt, black quilted vest, dark pants, and brown slippers with a hole in the toe leans over a dark wooden cabinet in a brightly lit indoor home. A ginger and white tabby cat is positioned near his feet, looking up at him. (2) The camera pans and cuts to various close-up angles of the ginger cat standing on a light-colored wooden floor. The cat rubs its side against the man's legs, looking up with wide eyes and moving its mouth as if meowing. (3) The man walks towards a white electronic pet feeder placed against a wall. The cat follows closely behind him, walking with its tail raised. (4) The man reaches down and interacts with a black plastic bag of cat food. He pours the kibble into the stainless steel bowl of the white feeder branded 'PET MARVEL'. The cat immediately lowers its head to begin eating. (5) Close-up shots show the cat eating the dry food while the man remains standing nearby, his dark trousers and the hole in his slipper visible in the frame.
